payload.text: Product Development & Automation Services | Andrews Cooper We engineer the technology that makes progress possible Andrews Cooper partners with ambitious companies to design, engineer, and industrialize breakthrough products and automation systems. Across Product Development, Automation & Robotics, and Integrated Engineering Teams, we help you move faster, reduce risk, and build what others can’t. Start a conversation One partner. End‑to‑end impact. We deliver deeply integrated engineering solutions that turn complex challenges into manufacturable, scalable outcomes with unwavering precision, reliability, and deep technical expertise. Explore our solutions AUTOMATION AND ROBOTICS Custom automation solutions for your most difficult challenges. PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT From concept through verification, validation, and manufacturing readiness. INTEGRATED ENGINEERING TEAMS Embedded experts who accelerate your roadmap without the overhead. Engineering that holds up when it matters. We bring together product, automation, and test expertise to turn complex ideas into systems that work — in the lab, in production, and in the field. Learn more about our expertise De-Risking & prototyping Early feasibility, trade studies, and targeted builds that resolve technical uncertainty before it becomes cost or schedule risk. Design & Development Integrated mechanical, electrical, embedded, and systems engineering that defines the right architecture early and carries it through production-ready design. Test, Verification & Validation Structured testing and reliability engineering that builds confidence in performance, compliance, and long-term durability. Low Volume Manufacturing Engineering support that bridges development and scalable production, ensuring designs translate into repeatable, high-quality builds. We partner with innovators across industries including 5 of the 10 biggest technology companies in the world. 25+ years Of engineering excellence across regulated and emerging technologies 170+ engineers Engineers spanning mechanical, electrical, firmware, and systems disciplines 50K+ sq/ft test lab & manufacturing floor Trusted by Fortune 500 and category-defining teams in ConsumerTech, MedTech, Semiconductor, Robotics & SpaceTech SELECT PARTNERS Opto-Mechanical Engineer Fortune 500, Consumer Electronics “Each of the staff I’ve worked with from AC has been very professional and add high value to their work streams.
